verification.import_summary: Windows system KERNEL32 and UCRT API sets only; no libc++ or libunwind DLL dependency

compatibility: Existing reconstructed C++17 sources generally portable; production renderer/decoder source scan found no GCC-only attributes or POSIX includes in selected reusable kernels.
Existing module CMake files unconditionally specify GCC flags, and some add Unix-only audit tests/linker wrap options. New foundation target should compile selected reusable source files directly.
For MSVC alternative gate -Wall/-Wextra/-Werror to /W4 and /WX, use /fp:strict for floating-point fidelity, replace Unix-only test APIs, and export symbols explicitly or use static libraries.
LLVM-MinGW supports existing GNU-style warning and floating-point flags. Use -static for executable runtime portability; Windows system UCRT remains an OS dependency.
No usable MSVC/Windows SDK/MinGW was installed in standard directories, user caches, or D: before portable acquisition. Android NDK clang existed but lacked native Windows SDK/sysroot.

commands.win32_link_libraries: user32 gdi32 opengl32 (as renderer implementation requires)
